notes.message: Restyled source: Button size to declared shape.icon-only; the slot declares no sized square member
Restyled source: Use the consumer modal scrim role (existing default40% and mode binding), replacing literal black10%; contrast thresholds stay unchanged.
Removed marker-only class absent from the pinned stylesheet
Rebound Button: the wrapper's size default is the Button's own; size is forwarded only when a caller passes it
Restyled source: Restyle unit line height to existing compact heading line height 1.15; do not alias a font-size-specific 5xl line-height member.
Restyled selected focusable surface: replace outline suppression with its own existing token-bound keyboard outline
Restyled source: Preserve decorative ring rendering, exact width and variants; never relabel as focus clearance.
